name: codebase-kb-engine
description: Generate a verifiable knowledge base inside any repository at .ckb/, ready to commit: five human-readable docs (architecture, workflows, business rules, system context) plus a machine-readable ckb.json in the open CKB v0.1 format, with path:line provenance and confidence on every claim. Skips regeneration when the committed KB is still fresh. Works on a local repo or a repo URL. A fail-closed, session-scoped gate allows writes only to .ckb/.
